proposed_from.topic: Sharp regret and post-selection inference for extreme-loss treatment policies under heterogeneous tail indices. MODEL: For each n>=2 and even m>=2 observe n iid records (X,A,L), X uniform on [m], A independent Bernoulli(1/2), with consistency and randomized treatment independent of both potential losses conditional on X. L(a)>=1. The unknown 2m conditional survival functions S_xa are genuine right-continuous survival functions supported on [1,infinity), and for every y>=1 satisfy |S_xa(y)/(c_xa y^(-alpha_xa))-1|<=D y^(-beta), with alpha_xa in [1,4], c_xa in [1/2,1], fixed known beta>0 and D in (0,1/4]. Atoms at 1 are permitted; all asserted generalized quantiles use inf{y:F(y)>=q}. All such laws are included; no common tail index, fixed gaps, or assumed estimator convergence is imposed. Within-person coupling of potential losses is arbitrary. Let Pi_m={pi:[m]->{0,1}:sum_x pi(x)<=m/2}. For 0<tau<=1/(8n), V_P,tau(pi)=Q_(1-tau){L(pi(X))} and V*_P,tau=min_pi V_P,tau(pi). The loss is logarithmic regret log(V_P,tau(pi)/V*_P,tau)>=0. Define R(n,m,tau)=inf over all measurable randomized learners hat_pi with values in Pi_m of sup over the stated Hall class E_P log(V_P,tau(hat_pi)/V*_P,tau). The full record is available to every learner; p_x and propensity are known to everyone. Study all joint sequences n tending to infinity, even m=m_n>=2 and 0<tau_n<=1/(8n), without pre-assuming vanishing regret. beta,D are fixed known constants. Quantiles are finite and positive under the two-sided polynomial tail envelopes. KERNEL: Determine R(n,m,tau) up to constants depending only on beta,D, including unavoidable logarithmic factors and the exact joint-sequence criterion for R tending to zero. Construct a computable capacity-constrained learner attaining the frontier and a same-Hall-class all-measurable-learner lower bound in the identified regimes. The theorem must be uniform over heterogeneous tail indices and local-to-tied tail mixtures; it must derive when sparse dominating cells versus many collectively contributing cells determine the learning difficulty. Neither a presumed rate formula nor a nonzero price for policy selection is part of the conjecture. As the inference rung, construct simultaneous confidence intervals for log V_P,tau(pi) over all pi in Pi_m with uniform asymptotic coverage >=.95, an explicit derived width bound, and consequently coverage for the selected policy; determine the regimes where their width vanishes instead of assuming it equals the regret rate. The key problem is the full population mixture under capacity, not per-cell conditional extreme effects. Exact rates, useful tail thresholds, choice of estimation method, local-dominance normalization and any selection/inference penalty are delegated to derivation. Merely establishing a plug-in upper bound, assuming a common tail index, or proving a fixed-tau policy theorem does not complete this kernel. COMPUTATION: Estimate each cell-arm survival tail with a total thresholded Hall-class estimator (threshold and bias correction to be derived). For each y, start with the sum of estimated control survivals and select at most m/2 most negative treatment-minus-control survival differences. This finite sorting step computes min_pi m^-1 sum_x hat_S_x,pi(x)(y). A scalar monotone inversion locates the minimal policy quantile, and the minimizing subset at that threshold returns a policy. Full enumeration over the finite policy class is an allowed fallback. Simultaneous bias-aware cell-tail envelopes propagate through every policy mixture and generalized quantile inversion without preclassifying dominant cells. Downstream derivation must prove validity, risk, and width uniformly from the raw sample. CONSUMER: Osama, Zachariah and Stoica, Learning Robust Decision Policies from Observational Data (NeurIPS 2020), equation (4), explicitly targets minimization of the marginal upper cost quantile under an unconfounded policy model, and supplies a published implementation (linked in its Section 4). Its finite-sample conformal approach can return an uninformative maximum-cost limit when information is inadequate; for unbounded cost this leaves extrapolated rare-loss choices uncertified. The proposed theorem would give this tail-cost policy workflow a model-based heavy-tail extrapolation rule and an explicit sample-size/covariate-complexity boundary for when choosing among capacity-limited policies is statistically justified. This is the same marginal loss-quantile decision object. No claim is made that the paper's bounded blood-pressure simulation or IHDP score empirically obeys a Hall tail. Xia-Zhang-Kong's ACTG175 analysis is a secondary example of quantile-oriented treatment choice, not evidence for heavy tails. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: A paired-cell Hall splice leaves survival equal to (3/4)y^-4 through a threshold T and changes it above T to (3/4)T^-delta y^-(4-delta), with delta=d T^-beta. The draft checks its original-class envelope and likelihood distance. If H heavy controls are missed, exact logarithmic regret h obeys 4h=log(1+(H/m)(exp(delta(b+h))-1)), where b is the oracle log quantile minus log T. This supports a two-cell rate spine proportional to log(1/tau)n^(-beta/(2beta+4)) and separated general bounds, subject to the listed count and testing proof gaps. Checks cover atoms, empty cells, arbitrarily distant extrapolation, local index ties, and population-mass-dependent dominance. Equal mean mistake counts can give different expected regret. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove matching bounds for the distribution of missed heavy cells under unrestricted capacity reallocation and show the hardest configurations cover the full heterogeneous Hall class; derive confidence widths separately. EARLY KILL TEST: Solve the paired-splice product-prior experiment from constant to log(m) testing information with exact expected log loss. Reject any proposed rare-error rate defeated by a capacity strategy; pivot if known generic machinery already supplies the full frontier. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/stat_extreme_policy_tail_mixture_frontier.md.

Theorem 3 of CarpentierKim2015 gives an adaptive one-tail upper rate in its probability display and Theorem 4 gives the adaptive lower bound with the unavoidable log-log factor. The proposal separately translates its relative remainder exponent by \\(\\beta_{\\mathrm{CK}}=\\beta/\\alpha\\), yielding the uniform worst-case exponent \\(\\varkappa=\\beta/(2\\beta+4)\\) used in \\(\\mathcal B_{\\mathrm{CK}}\\); AtheyWager2021 gives the regular-policy benchmark \\(\\mathcal B_{\\mathrm{AW}}\\). Neither classifies dense regimes where capacity averaging strictly changes the coordinatewise frontier, and neither supplies an honest-width lower bound for sign-indexed policy mixtures.","why_not_subsumed":"The generic theorem makes the comparison auditable: coordinatewise Hall estimation yields \\(\\mathcal B_{\\mathrm{CK}}\\), whereas regular additive-policy complexity is asymptotically nonrepresentative in every displayed vanishing Hall regime. The remaining product-prior problem determines exactly when capacity reallocation removes the coordinatewise logarithm. The explicit paired-splice hypercube makes the inference converse a separate mixture-separation problem rather than an appeal to scalar confidence-length theory.","strict_delta":"The requested result is an if-and-only-if frontier over the original heterogeneous Hall class that reports strict relations to the coordinatewise Hall plug-in and regular-policy baselines. Its inference counterpart must match the computable simultaneous upper system with a same-class paired-cell Assouad--Fano width lower bound.","chosen_kernel_reason":"This candidate has a verified legal Hall splice, an exact nonlinear regret identity, a solved two-cell boundary, a concrete early kill test, and a published same-estimand consumer. Its unresolved capacity-reallocation step is both mathematically specific and capable of invalidating the anticipated phase diagram, which makes the open content honest rather than decorative."}

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Determine the sharp minimax logarithmic-regret frontier for capacity-constrained policies minimizing a population extreme-loss quantile.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; equation (4); finite-sample validity result and its weighted-conformal proof; Conclusion
seed_details.summary: Derive the all-sequence minimax expected log-regret frontier, a computable capacity-sorting learner, and a matching same-Hall-class converse through sparse and collective tail-mixture phases.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the paper's featurewise conformal upper limit by the inverse of the full policy-mixture survival and analyze learning error after capacity sorting rather than pointwise decision certification.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for extreme-quantile policy minimax regret, Hall policy learning, and capacity-constrained tail mixtures found fixed-quantile treatment regimes, bounded-outcome minimax rules, and EVT reinforcement-learning algorithms, but no matching offline causal mixture frontier.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from CarpentierKim2015 cellwise tail rates plus AtheyWager2021 policy regret.
seed_details.rebuttal: The selected value is a nonlinear inverse mixture and the exact loss depends on the distribution of missed heavy cells after capacity reallocation; coordinatewise errors and additive-welfare regret do not determine it.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Uses the policy-regret motif rather than relabeling a fixed-estimand minimax problem; the open product-prior step is exposed.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Characterize the sparse-dominance-to-collective-contribution transition for growing heterogeneous mixtures.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Theorem 1 and Appendix proof based on row-maximum tail decomposition; Conclusion
seed_details.summary: Derive a uniform local-dominance normalization for policy-mixture quantiles when component masses vanish and tail-index gaps are of order \(1/\log(1/\tau)\).
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the maximum probability decomposition by the exact quantile root of a weighted sum of power tails, retaining every locally tied component before inversion.
seed_details.destination_search: EinmahlHe2023 targets a predetermined average tail and PanovMorozova2021 a predetermined impurity maximum; no source found a data-selected capacity mixture with local-to-tied exponents.
seed_details.red_team: The heaviest tail always dominates a finite mixture, so the phase map is elementary.
seed_details.rebuttal: With growing \(m\), the heaviest group's mass can vanish at the same logarithmic scale as its exponent advantage, producing a nondegenerate root involving both groups.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The limit object is the named dominance normalization; it is not another matched-converse seed.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Construct honest simultaneous confidence intervals for all capacity-feasible extreme policy quantiles.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Theorem 1 and its Hellinger-modulus proof; Theorem 3 for extreme quantiles and its extrapolation proof; Summary
seed_details.m11_subshape: limit law and honest confidence frontier
seed_details.summary: Lift worst-case Hall-bias inference to all selected policy mixtures, exploit top-capacity sorting to avoid an exponential class penalty, and characterize the width-vanishing frontier.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the scalar Hill functional by simultaneous cell-arm survival regions and propagate them through a shared top-capacity operator before generalized inversion.
seed_details.destination_search: HuangLiPeng2025 covers tail levels and fixed treatment pairs, while policy-confidence work starts from regular Gaussian scores; no simultaneous heterogeneous mixture-quantile system was located.
seed_details.red_team: Bonferroni cell intervals immediately give selected-policy coverage.
seed_details.rebuttal: Coverage is accessible, but the sharp maximal width and its sparse-versus-collective dependence require a modulus lower bound and stability analysis not supplied by a union bound.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Inference is a separate focal frontier and is not asserted to inherit the regret rate.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Construct a total bias-aware vector threshold estimator with empty-cell branches.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Theorem 3.3 on Hill-process concentration and its conditional exponential-order-statistic proof; Theorem 3.8 and its Lepski proof
seed_details.summary: Obtain a simultaneous random-count oracle inequality for \(2m\) Hall tails and a matching vector sup-log-error lower bound.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Condition the one-sample order-statistic representation on multinomial cell-arm occupancies and add a total no-information branch before calibrating a common familywise threshold.
seed_details.destination_search: Pooling papers require usable component summaries, and no random-empty-cell vector Hall oracle inequality with a selected-mixture loss was found.
seed_details.red_team: Condition on counts and union-bound BoucheronThomas2015.
seed_details.rebuttal: That supplies a conservative maximum-error bound but not rate-optimal aggregation under capacity; as a standalone result it is useful but not the main frontier.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Dropped because a union-bound vectorization risks being a technical lemma rather than a paper kernel.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Identify whether a logarithmic multiple-comparison cost is intrinsic to capacity sorting.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Theorem 1; lower-bound Theorem 5 and its shattered-set proof; Discussion
seed_details.summary: Characterize the exact effective selection dimension of top-half tail-survival sorting, distinguishing \(\log m\), policy-cardinality, and zero extra penalty.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the shattered-set local Gaussian sign experiment by paired Hall splices and evaluate exact log-mixture loss after feasible false-positive and false-negative reallocations.
seed_details.destination_search: Regular policy papers price VC or Gaussian-supremum complexity, while the destination sorting structure has no located tail-specific lower bound.
seed_details.red_team: The policy class has cardinality at most \(2^m\), so a standard union bound settles the penalty.
seed_details.rebuttal: Sorting evaluates only order statistics of \(m\) shared contrasts, and capacity can repair many coordinate errors; a policywise union bound can be exponentially loose.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Merged into the full regret frontier because the penalty is one regime of the same soft-loss experiment.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Derive a semiparametric efficiency bound for a heterogeneous extreme policy-mixture quantile.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Theorem 1 joint normality and optimal-weight construction; extreme-quantile pooling theorem and discussion
seed_details.summary: Seek a local asymptotic information bound and attaining estimator for one fixed policy-mixture extreme quantile under heterogeneous cell indices.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace common-tail geometric pooling by a pathwise derivative of the inverse heterogeneous average survival along local Hall perturbations.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found asymptotic variance optimization under common indices but no semiparametric efficiency calculation for the moving heterogeneous mixture quantile.
seed_details.red_team: DaouiaPadoanStupfler2024 already gives optimal weights and an extreme-quantile limit.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their estimand assumes common tail behavior, but the present moving quantile is nonregular over the full Hall class; a classical finite efficiency bound may not exist.
seed_details.search_obstruction: At \(\tau\le1/(8n)\), the target moves beyond the sample and is not pathwise regular over the unrestricted Hall envelope; the honest object is a minimax modulus, not a classical influence-function efficiency bound.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Generated to satisfy the M11 efficiency lane, then dropped because its regularity premise fails.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Obtain finite-sample post-selection coverage for unbounded extreme policy losses.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; equations (4)--(5); finite-sample validity result and proof; Conclusion
seed_details.summary: Invert a weighted conformal orbit augmented by a Hall tail model to certify beyond-sample selected policy quantiles.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the support-maximum fallback in the weighted conformal quantile by a tail-extrapolated conformity score whose law remains exchangeable after fitting cell tails.
seed_details.destination_search: No conformal method was found that gives nontrivial distribution-free coverage beyond an unbounded sample maximum while retaining the Hall-model extrapolation target.
seed_details.red_team: Weighted conformal prediction already provides finite-sample validity after policy learning.
seed_details.rebuttal: Its exact guarantee can become the support maximum and cannot alone extrapolate an unbounded \(1-\tau\) quantile when \(n\tau<1\).
seed_details.search_obstruction: Exact distribution-free symmetry cannot identify an unbounded beyond-sample quantile; adding Hall extrapolation breaks the pure M17 guarantee and returns the problem to model-based bias-aware inference.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Generated to satisfy the M17 lane, then dropped rather than disguising model-based inference as conformal exactness.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Obtain a process limit for extreme quantiles of heterogeneous treatment mixtures.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; extreme-quantile Theorem 4.3; treatment-effect process Theorem 5.1; proofs reducing extrapolation error to the tail-index process; Conclusion
seed_details.summary: Derive a Gaussian or non-Gaussian process limit for a fixed finite family of policy-mixture extreme quantiles under unequal cell tail indices.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace fixed-treatment ratio expansions by the derivative of log-sum-exp mixture inversion, allowing the active weights to vary with \(\tau\).
seed_details.destination_search: HuangLiPeng2025 covers treatment-status pairs and tail levels; EinmahlHe2023 covers predetermined averages; neither covers a growing capacity-policy index set.
seed_details.red_team: Apply the delta method to the vector of cellwise Hill estimators.
seed_details.rebuttal: A fixed-family limit is plausible, but uniform local ties and growing policy selection change the active weights and make it subordinate to the simultaneous-inference frontier.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Dropped as a fixed-policy limit-law paper because it does not solve selection over the capacity class.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Establish a nondegenerate moving-quantile treatment-choice frontier under the Hall envelope.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Theorem 3.6; lower-bound Theorem 3.10 and its spliced-Pareto Fano construction
seed_details.summary: Prove the exact two-cell regret rate \(\log(1/\tau)n^{-\beta/(2\beta+4)}\) and its if-and-only-if vanishing boundary.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Embed the spliced-Pareto tail alternatives into randomized treatment cells and translate index-testing error into exact log-quantile policy regret.
seed_details.destination_search: GuggenbergerMehtaPavlov2026 treats bounded fixed quantiles and finds degenerate minimax rules; no moving Hall-tail two-cell regret theorem was found.
seed_details.red_team: This is just CarpentierKim2015 with the estimation error multiplied by \(\log(1/\tau)\).
seed_details.rebuttal: The causal embedding and regret conversion are valid and useful, but the result is retained only as a boundary theorem because it does not address many-cell reallocation.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Demoted to a sanity-check theorem rather than presented as the flagship kernel.

banked_reason: D0.5 field-floor adjudication and independent validity gate: the all-sequence sharp regret frontier and exact vanishing criterion remain open in the unsaturated region, and the inference-width converse uses an invalid invariant separator; the proved partial phases are sound but incremental.
banked_proposal_promise_gap: The promised full joint-sequence sharp regret frontier, iff vanishing criterion, and matching confidence-width converse were not delivered; only the two-cell result, lower envelope, matched familywise/saturated phases, coordinatewise upper bound, and honest inference upper system were established.
